viewportReflowResolution.cause: WebKit updates/reflows the DOM scrolling root before innerWidth and visualViewport receive the new native view size. Dimension tracking based on lagging innerWidth lets a post-reflow scroll sample overwrite the pre-reflow cached paragraph fraction.
viewportReflowResolution.decisiveObservation: Markdown initial top=-541 height=1547 fraction=.349709. After widening, DOM paragraph width=508 and root.clientWidth=540 while innerWidth/visualViewport.width=390; top remains -541 with height=1247, fraction=.433841. This is anchor-cache timing, not a changed visual viewport top.
viewportReflowResolution.fix: viewportDimensions uses scrollingRoot.clientWidth/clientHeight first, with innerWidth/innerHeight fallback, so resize handling preserves the pre-reflow anchor before rememberViewport can overwrite it.
